job.title: Perioperative Services Manager
job.description:
Perioperative Services Manager | Permanent | Rockhampton, QLD

Lead a High-Performing Perioperative Team in Central Queensland An exciting opportunity is available for an experienced Perioperative Services Manager to join a respected private hospital in Central Queensland, Queensland.

This permanent leadership role is ideal for a passionate perioperative professional looking to lead a dedicated team while enjoying the lifestyle benefits of regional Queensland.

What's on Offer
  • Permanent full-time position
  • Competitive salary of approximately $156,000+ per annum (pending award increase)
  • Relocation assistance available 
    • Lump sum payment or
    • Salary packaging/salary sacrifice options
  • Supportive executive leadership team
  • Opportunity to influence clinical excellence, service delivery and team culture
  • Hospital willing to wait for the right candidate

About the Role As the Perioperative Services Manager, you will be responsible for the leadership and operational management of the perioperative department, ensuring high-quality patient care while supporting and developing your team.

Key responsibilities include:
  • Leading and mentoring the perioperative team
  • Managing day-to-day operational performance
  • Driving quality improvement initiatives
  • Workforce planning, rostering and resource management
  • Ensuring compliance with accreditation and clinical governance standards
  • Collaborating with multidisciplinary teams to deliver exceptional patient outcomes

About You To be successful, you will have:
  • Current AHPRA registration as a Registered Nurse
  • Minimum 5 years' perioperative leadership or management experience
  • Strong knowledge of theatre operations and perioperative services
  • Excellent leadership, communication and organisational skills
  • Commitment to delivering outstanding patient-centred care

Located on Queensland's stunning Capricorn Coast, this location offers an exceptional lifestyle with affordable housing, excellent schools, beautiful beaches nearby, and easy access to the Southern Great Barrier Reef.

Enjoy the perfect balance of career progression and work-life balance.

Apply Now If you're an experienced perioperative leader ready for your next challenge, we'd love to hear from you.
